# PaperLotLand — Las Vegas Off-Market Land Network

PaperLotLand is the private land developer and broker network for the Las Vegas Valley.
We specialize in off-market land deals across Clark County — including Las Vegas, Henderson, North Las Vegas, Boulder City, and unincorporated Clark County.

## What We Do

- Source off-market land parcels before they hit MLS or public listing
- Connect land sellers with qualified developers, investors, and brokers
- Provide GIS and zoning research resources for Clark County jurisdictions
- Operate a private network of buyers and sellers who move land in Southern Nevada

## Key Pages

- /available-lots/ — Current off-market inventory (private to network members)
- /closed-sales/ — Past closed land transactions with GIS data
- /off-market-deals/ — Join the off-market network
- /resources/ — GIS portals and zoning codes for all Clark County jurisdictions
- /resources/clark-county/ — Clark County GISMO, zoning, and development codes
- /resources/henderson/ — Henderson GIS and zoning resources
- /resources/north-las-vegas/ — North Las Vegas zoning resources
- /resources/boulder-city/ — Boulder City development codes
- /resources/las-vegas/ — City of Las Vegas zoning resources
- /blog/ — Land development insights, zoning guides, and market analysis
- /contact/ — Contact PaperLotLand

## Service Area

Clark County, Nevada — including the Las Vegas Strip corridor, Enterprise, Spring Valley, Henderson, North Las Vegas, Boulder City, and surrounding unincorporated areas.
